encounter: Mind Badge chapter cap 76 - Aqua Hideout and Routes 124-126 (play_order 229-240, E0340-E0367) [lead order: Incineroar + Mega Gardevoir]
availability_audit: Cap window resolved from the Game Book chapter ladder: C39 Heatran in Scorched Slab grants cap 76, C40 (the submarine theft, Aqua Hideout, opening the eastern sea) makes no cap change, and cap 84 only arrives with C42 the Space Center. Every battle in this block therefore sits at cap 76. Chronology of each member against pool-76.json source_detail, all of which precede the Lilycove coastal cave in play order: Incineroar gate 36 (Litten from the Mauville Game Corner at 500 coins, Torracat/Incineroar by level). Amoonguss gate 42 (Foongus, Petalburg Woods land table). Urshifu-Single-Strike gate 42 (Kubfu, legendary_sign Route112 - the Jagged Pass approach the player already used for the Magma Emblem - then EVO_SCRIPT_TRIGGER). Gardevoir gate 30 (Ralts Route102 land, Kirlia/Gardevoir by level) with ITEM_GARDEVOIRITE stone-window 14, long inside the Mega Ring window. Zapdos gate 30, legendary_sign NewMauville_Inside, the New Mauville shutdown cleared before the Feather Badge. Rillaboom gate 36 (Grookey from the Mauville Game Corner, Thwackey/Rillaboom by level). One reachable legend (Zapdos); nothing here is sourced from Mossdeep, Shoal Cave, the Space Center, Route 127-128, Seafloor Cavern, Sootopolis or anything else downstream of this block.
plan: Built against a faction that is eight-tenths Water with heavy Protect, Wide Guard and rain. Incineroar's Intimidate and Fake Out blunt the physical crews (Sharpedo's Speed Boost, Gyarados' Dragon Dance, Crawdaunt, Beartic, Kingler, Golisopod) and deny the free setup turn. Urshifu-Single's Unseen Fist is the direct structural answer to the faction's Protect and Wide Guard habit - Wicked Blow and Close Combat both land through a guard - and Wicked Blow is an always-crit, so Shell Armor Drednaw and stat-boosted bodies are the only exceptions worth tracking. Mega Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice is the spread answer to Dark, Dragon, Fighting and Poison bodies. Zapdos carries the Electric lane and is Ground-immune. Rillaboom supplies the Grass lane, priority Grassy Glide through a rain-doubled Swift Swim sweeper, and Grassy Terrain halves the Earthquakes and cuts Grassy Seed access for the Route 124 couple. Amoonguss is Spore plus Rage Powder, the general-purpose way to steal the turn a setup room needs. This ordering leads Incineroar beside Gardevoir so Intimidate and Fake Out land on the same turn as the first Pixilate Hyper Voice; identical six members and builds as party_aqua_76.json, lead order only.
